propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL environment variable is superseded by per-class model configuration (REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_PLAN_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_GATE_MODEL) and must be deprecated with a migration window rather than kept as permanent alias

The deprecation must be registered via _scheduled() in src/rebar/_deprecations.py with permanent=False and remove_in=_MAJOR, and the registry comment must clarify that this is a SUPERSESSION (not a rename) differing from the six permanent renames already in the registry

Deprecation warnings must be emitted at exactly two env-read sites: config.py:469 during config.from_env() and a new read in model_classes.py during slot resolution, with warnings routed through warn_deprecated to remain visible to gen_env_registry.py
When REBAR_LLM_MODEL is set and no per-class configuration exists, it must map to all three classes as a fallback default, with explicit class config taking precedence

Six prose files (README.md, docs/config.md, docs/llm-framework.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md, docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md, docs/env-vars.md) and four rendered operator-visible strings (_cli/_llm_commands.py:160, _mcp_llm.py:64, llm/config.py docstrings) must be updated to present the class configuration as current and mark REBAR_LLM_MODEL as deprecated

Four complete example configs (Anthropic-only, Bedrock-only, mixed-provider, local+fallback) must be added to docs as copy-paste-ready [tool.rebar.llm.model_classes] tables, and an ADR must record the class model and deprecation rationale
